_comment: Allowlist CEILING for agent built-in tools. Anything NOT listed here can never resolve, regardless of group config. Per-group denial is via container_config.deniedTools. mcp__nanoclaw__* is always available (IPC) and not listed here.
_reloadNote: Read per-spawn — edits take effect on the next container launch with NO host restart. (If this ever changes to module-load caching, update this note to say a restart is required.)
_taskNote: "Task" is the internal SDK tool name for subagent spawning. The model sees it surfaced as "Agent" (Explore, Plan, etc). The naming mismatch is a Claude SDK convention — Task here governs the Agent tool the model invokes.
